headline: UCCS turn the tables on Regis
dek: Regis had beaten UCCS on their own field in October, and UCCS have now won the return there, after Colorado Mesa did the same. The side that went through the conference table unbeaten has four defeats on the season; Rollins and Dallas Baptist took the others before conference play opened.
displaced_by: UCCS won at Regis on 2026-11-13, so the standing dek's claim of three defeats, only one of them to a member, is no longer true.
